experiment: Perfect numbers / Mersenne primes (Gap Ledger G27, G29)

euler_form.form: n = q^a * m^2, q prime, q = a = 1 (mod 4), m odd

honest_wall: Finite search only: no odd perfect number exists up to the search limit; the even perfect numbers are exactly those built from Mersenne primes (Euclid-Euler). The Mersenne list is exact (Lucas-Lehmer) only for exponents <= pmax. Whether any odd perfect number exists (best known bound > 10^1500) and whether infinitely many Mersenne primes exist both remain OPEN.
